title: TWILIGHT in Concert
seo_title: TWILIGHT in Concert: Live Score to Film
description: TWILIGHT in Concert is a live-to-film event where a 12-piece ensemble of rock and orchestral musicians performs the score while the original film plays on a full-size cinema screen. Over a thousand candles light the stage during the show. It is designed for devoted Twilight fans and newcomers alike, and tickets are sold through HammonsHall.com or MissouriStateTix.com, the only official sellers.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
